register.labelZh: IDENTIFY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: identify somebody with something 可以表示人們把某人與某個角色、團體或過往經歷緊密聯繫起來。；identify something with something 可以用來表達把成功與金錢、美貌與青春等概念聯繫起來的看法。；identify with 可以表示你因為有相似經歷,所以能夠理解另一個人的感受。；identify yourself with 和 be identified with 可以表示某人是否希望被公開視為與某個團體、活動或立場有關。
register.summaryEn: Identify somebody with something can show that people strongly connect a person with a particular role, group or part of their past. Identify something with something helps you explain beliefs such as connecting success with money or beauty with youth. Identify with helps you say that you understand another person’s feelings because you have had a similar experience. Identify yourself with and be identified with can describe whether someone wishes to be publicly connected with a group, campaign or set of beliefs.
